bootstrap_status.nb09_point_estimates_used: R-squared, delta R-squared and partial R-squared point estimates only; these are closed and are not affected by A6
bootstrap_status.on_a6_closure: If A6 requires a corrected paired construction, adopt the independently validated one for all later bootstrap block comparisons. No NB11 conclusion here depends on the held construction, so none needs revisiting for that reason.
bootstrap_status.reason: Claude-A has an open methodological review (A6) of the NB09 delta-R-squared bootstrap CI construction. NB11 therefore claims no bootstrap interval: stability is judged from point-estimate ranges across the pre-registered specifications in section 1, and from rank, conditioning and estimator-family comparisons.
